'''2006 Tennessee DPC Brian Rippetoe LS Watch Your Step (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brian Rippetoe]] at [[2006 Tennessee DPC]], finishing 1st; the list below is as posted on DeckTech by David "Lirkas 'DDM'" Destefanis (2006-06-15).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35598 DDM's Mynock Circus !]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060628060307/http://decktech.net:80/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35598&PHPSESSID=0a7a0cfb81258bb057790461d5e3ad7e Internet Archive]</ref>
